map.策略演示：优先打掉边缘砖块制造多段反弹，提高清屏效率。: Strategy demo: prioritize edge bricks to create multi-bounce paths and clear the screen faster.
map.挡板左右移动接球，球碰砖块即消并反弹；球落到底部（漏接）扣一条命；清空全部砖块过: Move the paddle left/right to catch the ball; the ball vanishes and bounces on hitting a brick; a missed ball (dropping to the bottom) costs a life; clear all bricks to win. Score = bricks smashed x per-brick value; consecutive catches without missing keep the ball-speed rhythm.
map.一排 10 块砖、每块 10 分：全清得 100 分；若中途漏接耗 1 命（共: A row of 10 bricks at 10 points each: clearing all gives 100 points; a mid-game miss costs 1 life (3 total) but you can continue with the remaining lives. Ball speed rises with level, so the paddle must predict the landing point earlier - a classic "reflection angle = incidence angle" geometry: catching left of center sends the ball up-right.
map.怎么让球路更可控？: How to make the ball path more controllable?
map.用挡板「边缘」而非中心接球可改变出射角；想打高处就偏接让球斜上，想保命就中心稳接: Catch with the paddle "edge" rather than center to change the exit angle; catch off-center to send the ball up high, catch center to keep it safe.
map.球速越来越快怎么办？: What if the ball gets faster and faster?
map.这是难度递增设计；保持球在底部中线附近、提前移动挡板接，比追着球跑更稳。: This is the difficulty-increase design; keep the ball near the bottom centerline and move the paddle ahead to catch it, which is steadier than chasing the ball.
